record.synthesis_method: mechanochemical synthesis (high-energy planetary ball milling in acetone)
record.evidence_quote: ionic conductivity of ~ 6x10−3 Ω−1 cm−1 at room temperature.
record.notes: Material name is given in the preceding abstract line ('amorphous 50SISOMO [50AgI-25Ag2O-25MoO3]'). Mobile ion is Ag+, recorded as 'other' per schema. The 0.20 eV activation energy is the high-temperature (221-300 K) Arrhenius value reported in the abstract and Section 3.1, not a value specific to room temperature. The Conclusions give a garbled conductivity value (~6 x 10 -1 cm-1 at 300 K) that is not reliably readable, so it was not recorded.
